rationale: Late-stage batch culture (44/48 h). Fermenting remaining carbohydrates (arabinose) and amino acids (Gly, Leu, Val, Pro, Asn, Gln) via mixed-acid fermentation. Producing butyrate and acetate in characteristic 2:1 ratio with CO₂. Uptake of residual acetate and ammonium supports growth stoichiometry. Carbon and nitrogen balance verified for 0.42 /h growth.
